abstract: Thyroid function was assessed in a total of 15 cases, 7 of whom had choriocarcinoma and 8 hydatidiform mole, by measuring free T3, free T4, thyroxin-binding globulin (TBG), basal thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) and after the thyrotropin-releasing hormone test (delta TSH). Free T3, free T4 and TBG were investigated in the same number of healthy women within the first three months of pregnancy. Only 13.4% of the cases presented elevated levels of free T3 and T4 and TBG; TSH and delta TSH were within normal limits. Both thyroid hormones and TBG returned to within normal limits when beta-human chorionic gonadotropin became undetectable. One patient was found to be hypothyroid. Comparison with the control group showed no significant differences except in TBG levels, which were higher in controls. A significant, direct correlation was found between levels of free T3 and T4 and TBG and the pattern of human chorionic gonadotropin.
abstract_ja: 甲状腺機能を、絨毛癌7例と胞状奇胎8例、計15例で評価した。測定項目は遊離T3、遊離T4、サイロキシン結合グロブリン(TBG)、基礎甲状腺刺激ホルモン(TSH)、およびTRH負荷試験後のΔTSHであった。遊離T3、遊離T4、TBGは、妊娠3か月以内の健常女性の同数の対象でも測定した。遊離T3、遊離T4、TBGがいずれも上昇していた症例は13.4%のみであった。TSHとΔTSHは正常範囲内であった。甲状腺ホルモンとTBGは、β-hCGが検出不能になると正常範囲に戻った。甲状腺機能低下症の患者が1例認められた。対照群との比較では、対照群でTBG値が高かったことを除き、有意差はなかった。遊離T3・T4およびTBGの値は、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のパターンと有意に相関した。
